The image reads as national-origin profiling, which is the exact risk the page's own DOJ source on work-authorization questions warns about. Stripe or Linear would not ship this (HUB_RULES 2a ship test), and it is a reputational and legal-optics risk for a hiring product. -> Make work authorization independent of how a name sounds: give the hold to an applicant whose name carries no national-origin signal, or mix names across both groups, e.g. hold "Tom Baker, Within band, not authorized" and shortlist "Ivan Petrov". Re-render uc-4 and keep the alt in step.
